title: Dune (1991 demo)
author: Cryo, for Virgin Games
blurb: The playable demo of Cryo's Dune: the Virgin and Cryo logos, then Arrakis.

title: Unreal
author: Future Crew
blurb: Future Crew's demo from Assembly '92. MIRAGE has no sound card: pick No sound with the arrows, then Enter.

title: DOOM (shareware)
author: id Software
blurb: Episode one, Knee-Deep in the Dead, from id's own 1.9 shareware archive. It runs on MIRAGE's DPMI host; no sound card.

title: Heretic (shareware)
author: Raven Software, published by id Software
blurb: The first episode of Raven's fantasy DOOM, from the 1.2 shareware archive. It runs on MIRAGE's DPMI host; no sound card.

title: Fractint 20.0
author: The Stone Soup Group
blurb: The classic fractal generator. Enter for the menu, then F3 for VGA 256 colours: it draws the Mandelbrot set; zoom with Page Up and Enter.

title: Plasma
author: MIRAGE
blurb: A flowing plasma in VGA mode 13h, redrawn every frame, palette set through the DAC ports.

title: Munching squares
author: MIRAGE
blurb: x XOR y in mode 13h with a rotating palette, synchronised on the vertical retrace.

title: VESA banks
author: MIRAGE
blurb: Finds 640×480×256 by walking the VBE mode list, then draws through five bank switches.

title: EGA planes
author: MIRAGE
blurb: The EGA write modes, set/reset, bit mask and latches, in 16-colour planar mode 0Dh.

title: CGA palette
author: MIRAGE
blurb: CGA mode 4: four colour bars across the two interleaved banks.

title: Helium
author: viznut (ocsa)
blurb: A 4K intro from Assembly '97: a lonely planet, a story told in text, its own music player.

title: Puls
author: Řrřola
blurb: A raymarched lattice of spheres in 256 bytes (Riverwash 2009). It wants a fast machine: each frame takes a moment.

title: Symetrie
author: Řrřola
blurb: A kaleidoscope of symmetric patterns, in 256 bytes.

title: Dírojed
author: Řrřola
blurb: “Hole eater”: an animated effect in 32 bytes.

title: Paralaxa
author: Řrřola
blurb: Parallax scrolling in 32 bytes, in the standard VGA palette.

title: TetrOS
author: Daniel Etzold
blurb: Tetris in a 512-byte boot sector. Arrow keys move, Up rotates.

title: Floppy Bird
author: Mihail Szabolcs
blurb: Flappy Bird as a bootable floppy, in 16-bit real mode. Space flaps.

title: BootChess
author: Olivier Poudade (Baudsurfer/RSi)
blurb: Chess against the computer in a 512-byte boot sector. Type a move such as e2e4 and press Enter.

title: bootRogue
author: Oscar Toledo G.
blurb: A roguelike in 510 bytes: random dungeons, monsters, the amulet. Arrow keys.

title: bootBASIC
author: Oscar Toledo G.
blurb: A BASIC interpreter in 512 bytes. Try: 10 print "hello" then run.

title: SectorLISP
author: Justine Tunney, Alain Greppin
blurb: A LISP with a garbage collector in a boot sector. Try: (CONS (QUOTE A) (QUOTE B))

title: sectorforth
author: Cesar Blum
blurb: A 16-bit Forth in 512 bytes: eight primitives (@ ! sp@ rp@ 0= + nand exit), and you define the rest. Try: : dup sp@ @ ;
